column4: Radio groups of option cards: arrow-key navigation (ARIA radio pattern)
column6:
S-109 audit item 22 (WCAG 2.1.1, moderate). OptionCard radio groups (Studio sign-in and registration factor, onboarding business type, verification checks dialog, payout frequency; consumer registration, food checkout) make every option a Tab stop and ignore the arrow keys.

Acceptance criteria:
- One Tab stop per group (the checked option, else the first)
- ←/→/↑/↓ move and select, Home/End jump
- a RadioGroup in @northline/ui used by every screen above
- Testing Library tests per screen
- axe still passes

Refs: docs/a11y/audit.md, docs/DECISIONS.md (S-109), docs/SCREENS.md

column4: Data Table under user text spacing (WCAG 1.4.12)
column6:
S-109 audit item 23 (moderate). The Data Table picks its columns from a width budget measured with the design's text metrics; with the 1.4.12 spacing (letter 0.12em, word 0.16em, line 1.5) the console's verification and vetting queues overflow at 1280 px.

Acceptance criteria:
- Column hiding measures rendered widths (or falls back to the card list) so no table scrolls sideways with user text spacing
- a Playwright check in packages/a11y applies the spacing on the queues and finds no horizontal scroll

Refs: docs/a11y/audit.md, docs/DECISIONS.md (S-109), docs/SCREENS.md

column4: Headings: no skipped levels, error states keep the page h1
column6:
S-109 audit item 29 (WCAG 1.3.1/2.4.6, minor). Studio payouts and settings go from h1 to h3; when a screen fails to load (consumer cart, route errors) the error state replaces the page and its h1.

Acceptance criteria:
- Studio payouts and settings use h2 for their sections
- every screen's error and loading states keep the screen's h1
- the page sweep's heading-order and page-has-heading-one findings are gone

Refs: docs/a11y/audit.md, docs/DECISIONS.md (S-109), docs/SCREENS.md

column4: Screens' own controls at 44 px (design rule)
column6:
S-109 audit item 25 (WCAG 2.5.8 is met at 24 px; the 44 px is docs/SCREENS.md). The kit's buttons, chips, tabs and menu items are 44 px now; screens' own controls are not all — Data Table row actions (36 px), its chips (32–34 px), some icon buttons. The page sweep counts them per page (targetsUnder44 in a11y-results).

Acceptance criteria:
- Every control on the swept screens offers a 44 px target (size or hit area
- inline text links exempt)
- the sweep fails above zero

Refs: docs/a11y/audit.md, docs/DECISIONS.md (S-109), docs/SCREENS.md

column4: Step bars: contrast of the steps still to do
column6:
S-109 audit item 30 (WCAG 1.4.11, minor). StepBars draws the steps not yet done at 1.4:1 against the page.

Acceptance criteria:
- Steps to do reach 3:1 (or the bar says "Step 2 of 3" in text next to it)
- the token contrast test lists the pair

Refs: docs/a11y/audit.md, docs/DECISIONS.md (S-109), docs/SCREENS.md

column4: Consumer web: help for guests in a consistent place (WCAG 3.2.6)
column6:
S-109 audit item 31 (minor). "Help & cases" is only in the signed-in account menu; a guest has no help link.

Acceptance criteria:
- A Help link in the footer of every consumer page (en/fr) leading to help and contact for guests and signed-in people alike

Refs: docs/a11y/audit.md, docs/DECISIONS.md (S-109), docs/SCREENS.md

column4: Console delivery map: stuck couriers not by colour alone (WCAG 1.4.1)
column6:
S-109 audit item 32 (minor). On the ops map a stuck courier differs from a moving one only by colour (the runs table says "stuck" in text).

Acceptance criteria:
- Stuck couriers get a second cue on the map (shape or outline) and the legend shows it

Refs: docs/a11y/audit.md, docs/DECISIONS.md (S-109), docs/SCREENS.md

column4: Consumer app: control names without the ▾ glyph
column6:
S-109 audit item 33 (WCAG 2.5.3, minor). VoiceOver/TalkBack read the ▾ in names such as the search sort ("price, low to high ▾"); the home address kicker is fixed.

Acceptance criteria:
- Every control's accessibilityLabel leaves out decorative glyphs (en/fr-CA)
- __tests__/a11y.test.tsx checks for them

Refs: docs/a11y/audit.md, docs/DECISIONS.md (S-109), docs/SCREENS.md

column4: Screen-reader pass of the journeys before launch
column6:
S-109 checked the accessibility tree automatically and by hand, on recorded fixtures; nobody listened. Before the pilot, run the main journeys (Studio sign-in to KDS, consumer search to checkout and booking, console queues) with real data.

Acceptance criteria:
- VoiceOver (macOS, iOS), NVDA (Windows) and TalkBack (Android) passes recorded in docs/a11y/audit.md with any new findings ticketed
- the accessibility statement's "last reviewed" date updated

Refs: docs/a11y/audit.md, docs/DECISIONS.md (S-109), docs/SCREENS.md
